You probably have heard about this before, just thought I would mention it.
I am not sure if the problem is in lisp or in macsyma.
When you rubout quickly, macsyma does the rubout, but doesnot do the backspace
and erase character. So that the screen is not correct, but macsyma gets
the right thing for example if I type 
FOOBAR<rubout,rubout,rubout>; then the screen echos FOOBAR;
but macsyma returns FOO
